title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Closed-form Solutions
text: A closed-form solution is an explicit equation that can be solved directly. In the context of linear regression, closed-form solutions exist for ordinary least squares but not necessarily when regularization is applied.
